spiritual_reading.full_translation:
After the Divine life had completed the ordering of all things and their subordinate formations, it turned itself toward the outermost degree and established itself there. It gave an impulse to the Divine governance of truth, and the full arrangement of successive states was set in motion and elevated into a higher order. Then an encompassing influx of truth was extended into those ordered states; life was breathed into them; their activities were awakened; and the outermost degree was cleansed by that influx.

Then the impure remainder and hardened encrustation from a complete mixture of corrupt influences—those arising from falsified understanding, from active denial of good, and from perverted love—which had flowed down into the outermost degree, were gathered up and confined within the common repository of external knowledges, held inside fixed bounds and containing forms. Because that repository received what was harsh and acrid from the cleansing of those mixed corruptions, the knowledges there became bitter and resistant to spiritual enjoyment.

When Divine life rose into higher states, it released the ordered progression of cognitions that governs changes and seasons of state. It cleansed that progression, loosened all thickened falsity within it, and cast the loosened remainder down from an elevated state into that same common repository of externals. The remainder from that cleansing was mingled into the general knowledges. A dominant intention within that repository collected what was scattered; and that intention bound and fixed the gathered residue so it became stable in the lowest degree.

Upon this fixed composite, the measurements of successive states were impressed: lesser and greater changes, extended cycles, and the determinations of cognition with their ordered varieties. It arose from those determinations, was removed from their active government, and was confined within the general external repository. Upon it were impressed the appearances, settled patterns, persuasive teachings, deliberations, and governing aims that remained from that former progression, because it was the condensed remainder of them all. Therefore, whenever any cognition is kindled into prominence or any ordered variety turns into effect, this composite serves, for one, as an incitement and, for another, as a confirmation.

It was brought down into the general repository as a common inflow pours into what is general and is received there. It was compelled into that state entirely by the operation and governance of ministering powers. It was carried into the place of reduction and formation where the ordered whole was established in its ultimate working; and the general repository of externals also received it and cooperated in shaping it, being the principal agent in giving it determinate form. It was formed into a representative structure, and it underwent more alteration than the other residual composites stored in that general external plane.

This process is like the way innumerable distinct determinations from many sources can be gathered into one: their separate markings are dissolved, and the multitude of prior forms is brought into a single coherent whole.

So it was with this fixed composite within externals: it too was shaped and set by the force of inward craving within it, assembled from many persuasive teachings and deliberations drawn from the remaining elements of that ordered progression of cognitions.

The governing pattern for producing this composite was for three uses.

First, that the progression of cognitions might be relieved and cleansed of the oppressive remainder within it. As the full outer arrangements had been purified and lightened from the burden of the mixed corruptions, so the progression itself was also relieved and cleansed of the burden and residue held inside it.

Second, that there might be added a restraint and confinement upon that progression and its ordered varieties bound to it, so that when they strive to rise beyond their proper degree, the fixed composite within external knowledges drags them back by a hard constraint and they cannot ascend. And when the powers of that progression incline toward deceit and intend to flow down into the outermost degree, they cannot descend, because a fixed arrest is set at the boundary of the ultimate arrangements. This is one restraint; yet another restraint, by constant supervision from vigilant guardings set over it, keeps it compelled into continual regulated motion.

Third, that all general influxes of truth, together with the diverse movements of understanding and love that surge within the circuit of externals, and the streams of thought that traverse the outermost degree and return into what is general, and the descending influxes that terminate in ultimates, and the residues and renewals that come down with them—might all have in that general repository a common lodging and place of collection.

And as to all force and vitality that descends into that general repository, and as to the inbreathing by which this fixed composite draws that vitality into itself so as to agitate what is general: from its motion there arises a fullness and interaction that tends toward purification; yet the continuation is unresolved here, as though the account breaks and does not fully disclose the outcome.

paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES the establishment of order by moving from creation to purification and confinement of residual corruption in externals.

paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the theme of purification by adding a second cleansing and the fixing of what is cast down into externals.

paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by describing the internal structure of the fixed composite and its ongoing influence on cognitions.
paragraph_translations.notes: The list of measurements and varieties is dense; several items overlap in function and resist sharper distinction.

paragraph_translations.notes: “Place of reduction and formation” is forced: the source’s grinding/constructing image is clear, but the exact spiritual nuance could be either purification by friction or consolidation into use.

paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by identifying inward craving as the formative force organizing the residue into one fixed composite.
paragraph_translations.notes: The inward craving reads as disordered desire; the exact moral valence could be mixed, but the tone suggests compulsion rather than purified appetite.

paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS from describing formation to stating purposes.

paragraph_translations.notes: The closing clause in the source is fragmentary; the intended final assertion about continuation or cessation resists a clean, finished spiritual statement.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Strong coherence through ¶2–¶11: a single process of cleansing higher orderings, casting down residues into externals, forming a fixed composite, and stating three uses (purging, restraining, and receiving). The voice becomes less stable in ¶10 (two restraint mechanisms spliced) and breaks in ¶12 where the concluding effect is stated but not completed, leaving the final outcome unclear.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential substrate: the teaching proceeds by function (washing, gathering, salting) and the spiritual reading arises smoothly from the natural operations described.
findings.evidence: Text teaches by operations: “he spread forth the wind… he washed the earth with the waters… he gathered them and deposited them in the sea… because of this sea waters are salty.” The spiritual reading tracks this without strain as purification + confinement of residues in externals, and notes no narrative break here.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential continuation: casting down ‘sediment’ and its consolidation is functional and narratively continuous with ¶2.
findings.evidence: “he washed it out and loosened all the sediment… cast it down to this great inner sea… Its own thought collected it together… made it fast and fixed it.” The spiritual reading’s ‘dominant intention… bound and fixed’ is a direct functional mapping; no stumble beyond ordinary density.

findings.diagnosis: Primarily correspondential but with a systematizing-lexical accretion that increases density and blurs function: the piling up of abstract terms (‘aspects… doctrines… counsels’) reads like a schematic overlay at a seam, not needed for the narrative logic (residue bears imprints of the star-wheel).
findings.evidence: The core functional point is clear: residue bears the “seal of the seconds and the hours… impression of the stars and the signs of the zodiac,” hence it can serve as “inducement… confirmation.” But the expanded chain “images and the seals and aspects and doctrines and counsels” is conceptually heterogeneous and not grounded in a single natural function; the spiritual reading explicitly “stumbled” here: “The list… is dense; several items overlap in function and resist sharper distinction.” This is a classic symptom of secondary elaboration: additive terminology amplifying ‘imprint’ into an encyclopedia of categories.
findings.scope: Remove the schematic additive string: “The images and the seals and aspects and doctrines and counsels of [the wheel of the stars] were sealed upon the body of that giant,” while retaining the functional ‘seal/impression’ material and the concluding inducement/confirmation logic.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential exposition with a stable illustrative analogy (coin-impressions → single image; lust as formative force). The narrative is continuous (descent → formation → analogy → application).
findings.evidence: Functional mechanics dominate: “helmsmanship of the angels… swept down to the mill… sea… chief sculptor… It sculpted him in a likeness.” The ‘coins in fire’ analogy (¶6) explains consolidation by function. The spiritual reading notes only a nuance question (“mill” image), not a narrative break: “the source’s grinding/constructing image is clear.” ¶7 grounds formation in a motivating force (“lust inside him”), again functional causality.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential ‘three uses’ structure: purposes are stated as functional roles (purge burden; restrain motion; serve as receptacle). This matches substrate-style teleology by use/function, not jurisdictional administration.
findings.evidence: “constructed for three things… First… relieved and purified… Second… add a fetter and a prison… Third… sea will be a hostel and gathering place.” The spiritual reading reports “Strong coherence through ¶2–¶11” and reads all three as functional uses of the sea-giant within the cosmological process.

findings.diagnosis: Minor seam/patchwork inside an otherwise coherent paragraph: two restraint mechanisms are spliced with abrupt deictics (“This is one. However, this other one…”) causing a perceptible internal jolt. Likely a small expansion stitching together two traditional explanations (boundary-stake preventing descent; watchers enforcing continuous turning).
findings.evidence: Text jumps: after explaining the ‘iron fetter’ and the ‘stake… nailed to the wheel,’ it abruptly reclassifies: “This is one. However, this other one, because of its sleepless watchers… it is turned all the time.” The spiritual reading flags exactly this: “transition feels abrupt, as if compressing two mechanisms.” This reads like an added gloss preserved in-line rather than a fully separate administrative block (no named jurisdictions; still functional).
findings.scope: Excise the likely stitched addendum: “This is one. However, this other one, because of its sleepless watchers that are set over it, it is turned all the time.”

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty from damage/fragmentation at the close, not an administrative intrusion. The sentence breaks off (“but the sea [does not cease.]”) leaving the stated effect unresolved.
findings.evidence: The restored text itself is unstable: “in the breath… [there is] fullness and a [interaction] becomes… [that will] purify; but the sea [does not cease.]” The spiritual reading notes a narrative break specifically due to fragmentary ending: “closing clause… is fragmentary… resists a clean, finished spiritual statement.” Removing it would not restore a better conclusion; it would only remove the attempted conclusion entirely.

textual_criticism.summary: 6 findings: 3 clean correspondential stretches (¶2-¶3; ¶5-¶7; ¶8-¶11), 2 localized seam/expansion issues recommended for excision (the schematic term-chain in ¶4; the spliced ‘This is one… this other one…’ addendum in ¶10), and 1 genuine difficulty due to damaged/fragmentary closure (¶12) with no excision recommended.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: After the Living Spirit constructed things and the worlds, he came up and set himself upon this earth. He gave a sign to the King of Glory, who turned the three wheels and caused the wheels that are found [in their place] up above all the mountains; he spread forth the wind to them, he breathed on them, he stirred them up, he washed the earth with the waters. And the waste and the accretion of the three vessels, they of water and of Darkness and of fire, which had been discharged upon the earth, he gathered them and deposited them in the sea that is within the walls and the vessels; because of this sea waters are salty. For they have received salt and bitterness from the washing out and cleansing of the three vessels.

When the Father of Life came, rising in his ascent to the heights, he discharged the wheel of the stars; he washed it out and loosened all the sediment that was in it. He cast it down to this great inner sea like [a stone] of the mountain. And that waste, the sediment of the washing out of the wheel, he cast it down and mixed it in with the sea waters. Its own thought collected it together; and the thought gathered the waste together in this way. It made it fast and fixed it [in the depths]

The sea giant had stamped upon him the seal of the seconds and the hours, the seal of the days and months and years, the impression of the stars and the signs of the zodiac [and the courses of the seven planets.] He came into existence from them and was discharged from their power and cast into the sea. Because he is the residue of them all. Consequently, each star that will shine, and each sign of the zodiac that will turn: of one he shall be its inducement, and of another its confirmation.

He was discharged into the sea like this, the way a cloud might discharge rainwater into the midst of the sea. They compelled him totally through the action of the power and the helmsmanship of the angels. He was swept down to the mill, the place where he was constructed in the setting up of the universe; and the sea also conceived him [and took hold of him] for its part [in the work of his shaping;] it being his chief sculptor and chief craftsman. It sculpted him in a likeness, he being changed more than the other residue of the sea bodies.

This matter is comparable with a craftsman who might take the stamped impressions of many coins and cast them on the fire, and mould them [to a single] image. These thousands of impressions and thousands of shapes [are perfected] and make a single body [and become one form.]
This is also the case with the sea giant, who too was moulded and sculpted by the power of the lust inside him from many doctrines and counsels that belong to the residue of the wheel of the sphere.
The archetype of the giant was constructed for three things.

The first: That the sphere would be relieved and purified of the burden present in it. In the same way that the ten firmaments were purified and relieved of the burden of the three vessels; so was it also done to the sphere, that it too might be relieved and purified of the burden and the waste inside it.

The second: That he might add a {fetter} and a prison to the wheel and the signs of the zodiac that are bound to it, so that when they wish to go up above, you can find the sea giant dragging them back as by an iron {fetter}, and they are unable to go up; and when the powers of the wheel would take a decision on a guileful thing, and it enters their mind to come down to the earth, they are not able to descend because of this stake that is nailed to the wheel upon the {} of the firmaments.

The third thing: That the wind and the water and the fire that gush from the circuit of the sea, and the rivers that flow upon the face of the earth discharging into the sea, and the rainwaters that come to ground, and the waste and rebirth that come down to it; that sea will be a hostel and gathering place for all of these.

As for all the power and the life that comes down to the sea, and in the breath that the sea giant will breathe and draw it into him that he might disturb the sea [there is] fullness and a [interaction] becomes between his movement [that will] purify; but the sea [does not cease.]

changes_summary: Implemented excisions per the critic’s recommendations: (1) In ¶4, removed the schematic additive string “The images and the seals and aspects and doctrines and counsels of [the wheel of the stars] were sealed upon the body of that giant,” as identified in Finding 3, while preserving the functional seal/impression framework and the inducement/confirmation conclusion; minimal grammar smoothing followed the removal. (2) In ¶10, excised the stitched addendum “This is one. However, this other one, because of its sleepless watchers that are set over it, it is turned all the time.” as specified in Finding 6. All other paragraphs unchanged (Findings 1, 2, 4, 5, 7: none/annotate-only).
